name: Love Mansion
source:
Once a prominent streamer, you're now unemployed and drowning in financial troubles—until a lifeline suddenly appears: Akari, the youngest daughter of a prestigious local family, has one goal—getting into a top-tier university—and she's in desperate need of a private tutor.This is your chance!

Your new job comes with an invitation to move into her family's opulent mansion, where you'll share a roof with four uniquely charming women. It sounds like the perfect escape from your current struggles... but appearances can be deceiving.
Akari's crucial exam is only 30 days away. The pressure is relentless and every moment counts. You’ll need to manage your time and energy carefully, as you unravel the secrets hidden within the lives of your new housemates

......which, of course, includes a healthy dose of naughty secrets!Tread carefully and don't get caught!


[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3207780/Love_Mansion/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
曾经是一位著名的主播，现在却失业并陷入财务困境——直到一条救生索突然出现：当地名门望族的小女儿明里有一个目标——进入一所顶尖大学，而她迫切需要一名私人导师。这是你的机会！

你的新工作邀请你搬进她家的豪华豪宅，在那里你将与四位独特迷人的女性共享一个屋顶。这听起来像是摆脱当前困境的完美逃离……但外表可能具有欺骗性。
距离明里的关键考试只剩下30天了。压力是无情的，每一刻都很重要。当你揭开新室友生活中隐藏的秘密时，你需要仔细管理你的时间和精力

……当然，其中包括一些顽皮的秘密！小心行事，不要被抓住！


[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3207780/Love_Mansion/]Steam[/url]]
